svg.text: One regulator now vouches for half of everything newly prequalified
Every prequalified vaccine as one dot: the year it was prequalified, against the national authority that signed it off. 285 products, 22 authorities.
CDSCO (India) has not just the largest share — a growing one: 41% then 45% then 50%. before 2010 n=91, 2010–2017 n=88, since 2018 n=106.
No binning in the encoding — every dot is a real year. The three era figures are a check on the eye, not the chart.

22 authority STRINGS, 21 bodies: “CBER/FDA” and “US Food and Drug Administration- Office of Vaccine Research and Review” are the same regulator. Left unmerged — the publisher’s values are not rewritten here.
Small vertical offsets separate products prequalified in the same year by the same authority. Read with oversight-matrix.svg, which shows whose products those are.
